participation.context: Sewed the packet and did not go out.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You sewed the two groats into the paper at the lodging and left the Bell for after the play.

title: Sewed the groats in and stayed home

participation.context: Wrote the outside, asked after the cough, and paid.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Priced the road, took the packet, and gave Anne's letter back.
participation.name: Thomas Hobbins

story.body: You paid twopence, wrote the one plain line on the outside, heard that the cough is mending, and did not name a day for coming home.

title: Gave Hobbins the late letter and took Anne's letter

description: Her letter, as far as the well

participation.context: Read the leaf and did not add a question to it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the pan, the ladle, the quarrel, and the one word for the cough.

title: Read Anne's letter of the pan, the ladle, and the well

participation.context: Wrote the line and shut the book.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the one line for the carrier and left the rest of the page unsummed.

title: Entered the twopence for the carrier

participation.context: Said the word once, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You stopped at mending, and you did not write a day you do not know.
